## Standing operator rules
Keep commits small so review stays easy. Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.

Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Finish and validate invoice PDF rendering improvements; refund reconciliation is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`; `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`; invoice 1048. `ci-runner-small` is retired; use `ci-runner-arm64`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Positive-only filtering omitted credit lines. Raw point-height division was replaced by `_row_height(points)`. `ci-runner-small` hangs.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Render negatives; use `format_money`; reserve headers once.
- [pending] Run `pytest tests/test_invoice_pdf.py::test_long_invoice_paginates -q -vv`.
- [pending] Run full PDF tests and Ruff.

## Recent work
Long-invoice test initially produced `assert 3 == 2`; header-reservation fix was applied but remains unverified.
